population: Mandarin lip-reading decoders: text-output lip-reading, VSR or AVSR systems that take lip or face video at test and report a result on a Mandarin corpus (LRW-1000, CMLR, CAS-VSR, CN-CVS, CNVSRC, MAVD, own corpora). Excluded: perception, neuroimaging and education studies, surveys, dataset or challenge description papers that report no decoder (dataset papers with baseline decoders such as LRW-1000 are included), enhancement, separation, synthesis and talking-face generation, cued speech, keyword spotting, non-visual modalities, non-Mandarin decoders. Versions merged by title (titles filled from manifests). Dated by first public version against 2019-08 (window 2019-02 to 2020-02 = concurrent).

topics.inclusion_rule: The Mandarin lip-reading decoder population (plan.population), classified from the full text (reference list removed) by the intermediate units named: pinyin or syllables, explicit tone prediction or tone labels, a multi-stage cascade, or none (direct characters or word classes). Boundary: counts are mentions (pattern match, upper bound; related-work discussion included); a study counts under every design its text names; versions once.

The same Mandarin lip-reading decoder population, classified from the full text (reference list removed) by how the text references of the corpus are named: ASR-generated transcripts, broadcast subtitles or manuscripts, or manual checking or annotation. Boundary: mention counts (pattern match, upper bound), including descriptions of reused corpora; versions once.

Boundary: mention counts (pattern match, upper bound); versions once.
